descriptionHtml:
Bug A1 · P2 · accessibility

Buttons, inputs and dropdowns have no accessible name (Nursing Home +, settings, back, close X, task done/delete, medication status dropdown); also some focus jumps to the top and small tap targets

Tickets: — · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: local (visual check)

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): OAT-01/S21, OAT-06/S24b, TC-03/S21, TC-12/S20, TC-14/S22, TC-19/S21, TC-21/S20, TC-22/S20

Approach · TC-11 Course Timeline · S20 Course panels: axe (WCAG 2 A/AA) in read and edit states, and layout on phone width and WebKit

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T4 The timeline is readable as a quick trend view across the stay. (TFA-92589 AC 8; UAT TC-11)
  • U3 Hospital: the timeline shows yesterday and today only, per the retention rules. (UAT TC-11; UAT 3.6; TFA-92589 AC 4)
  • U4 Nursing Home: entries are keyed by visit number and labelled 'Visit N – date'. (UAT TC-11; TFA-92589 AC 5)

Test design technique: Accessibility (accessibility) — Check screen-reader, keyboard, contrast and tap-size rules (axe): users with disabilities have to be able to use it too.

Given Hospital chart with two course cards and NH chart with three visit cards, one entry of 60 words each; desktop Chrome, Pixel 7 (Chromium) and iPhone 15 (WebKit) profiles; then each timeline editor open

When The visual lane runs axe and its layout checks on hospital-chart-preround and nh-chart-preround in both states, with the course panel scrolled into view

Then No serious or critical violations; the Edit / Save / Cancel timeline buttons have accessible names, the editor textarea has a label, and the entry text meets AA contrast. Entries wrap with no horizontal scroll and no clipped text; 'Visit N – <date>' is not truncated; the Edit buttons are at least 24 px (44 pt on iPhone)

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): axe-core results (visual-checks.ts): zero serious or critical violations on the four states; visual-lane overflow / truncated / tap = 0 on both course panels; screenshots for vision-review (findings, not Pass/Fail). Folded in from the former S21; a real phone is S22

Where it ran: local visual lane (screenshots + axe); test method VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person); lane planned in the matrix: visual / mobile (automated)

S20 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-11.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: Accessibility · environment local · tickets TFA-92589 ready for qa

In Hospital the course-timeline editor box has no accessible name, so a screen-reader user lands in an unnamed text box. On iPhone the Edit buttons are 24 px tall (44 pt expected), and the Nursing Home course header fails contrast.

Evidence: allure c3cd2ce7, visual lane: 53 passed, 18 failed. axe flags 'label' as critical on the Hospital editor textarea. The layout passes: entries wrap, 'Visit N – <date>' shows in full, and Edit, Save and Cancel are named.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane visual.

Test method: VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: visual.

UAT item: TC-11 Course Timeline · Section: A2 · Pre-Round · Scenario: TC-11/S20

Course panels: axe (WCAG 2 A/AA) in read and edit states, and layout on phone width and WebKit

Tickets: TFA-92589 Course Timeline (ready for qa)

New local lane visual: status failed in visual/results.json → failed · product (failed · product (the lane flagged a product issue)).

How it is tested (visual/plan.json, automatable: yes): preround.spec.ts: Hospital course (yesterday + today, 60-word entries) and NH visit timeline (3 visits); read and edit states scoped to the course panel: axe, Edit/Save/Cancel names, textarea label, overflow/truncated, 'Visit N – <date>' whole, Edit buttons >= 24 px (44 on iPhone). [2026-10-14 review] Label rule follows the oracle (axe, whose 'label' rule accepts a placeholder): judged = the textarea has an accessible name; a placeholder-only name is recorded for a person. 'truncated' added to the edit state. — A real phone is S22, not this scenario.

Detail:

desktop, iphone15, pixel7: 53 judged check(s) passed, 18 failed. Entries wrap with no horizontal scroll or clipping; 'Visit N – <date>' lines are whole; Edit/Save/Cancel are named.

Product issue: In Hospital the course-timeline editor textarea has no accessible name at all — no label and no placeholder (axe 'label', critical): a screen-reader user lands in an unnamed text box. On iPhone the Edit buttons are 24 px tall (oracle: 44 pt on iPhone). NH course header contrast fails.

Recorded-only cells (recorded): The Nursing Home timeline textarea is named only by its placeholder 'One line per visit…' (passes axe; recorded for a person, WCAG 3.3.2).

Evidence: 8 attached; 1 not attached:

  • visual/evidence/TC-11_S20 — a folder (27 items), not attached

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane V: visual-lane.ts reads a make-session.ts fixture (a fresh local account made with the admin key), and make-session.ts refuses dev, so it runs on the local stack only (2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
